text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To become something "special" to Agnes Digital and Air Shakur. Tap Dance City continued to chase that romance, but—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaaaah?! M-My treasured bromides collection is blowing away in the wind...?!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me! —Hah!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, "partner". I caught every single one of your treasures out of midair—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, whoa-whoa! Was that really enough to make you foam at the mouth and faint?!
You don't gotta be THAT moved by it~!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Damn it, I need more data on Front Runners. And specifically from an umamusume with proven results—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Oho, "proven results"? Are you finally callin' my name, Shakur?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Annoying. Beat it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —Look. Knock off the irritating bullshit already.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: No way! I'm not stoppin' until I bust open those hearts of yours!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...You get all the cheers and adoration from the students you help out, and you have your fun with it. Don't tell me that's not enough for you.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it's not enough! I haven't gotten what I really want yet!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: What I'm after isn't praise or respect. I want to do something huge together with my crew—with my partners!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Right now, the "romance" I'm searching for... is becoming true comrades with you guys. That's it!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ...Shakur, you said it before. That Digital doesn't have a single "special" person. And that you have zero interest in that stuff either.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Just watch! That logic of yours? I'm gonna completely overturn it!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I know it won't be easy, though.
—...Hm?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Heheheh... Today is the long-awaited concert...! It's burning! My otaku soul is burning with passion...!

text_block_list.name: Sobbing Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: *Sniff*... *Hic*...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huh?! W-What's the matter?!

text_block_list.name: Sobbing Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: T-Today was supposed to be the concert, but... I lost my ticket...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: !! That is a major catastrophe! I will assist in the search at once!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...It's not here either, huh...
Mmmgh... It's almost time for the concert to start—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: —Gaaah! Why are you hesitating, Digi-tan?! A horse girl's smile is infinitely more important than your own desires, is it not?!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! That's our Digital for ya!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: T-Tap-shan?! Why are you here?!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Oh, just passing through! Let's find it together, you and me!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: —A-Found it! The ticket is right over there!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ...Urgh, b-but... Of all places, it's stuck on a sheer slope... My hands can't reach it...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'll climb down and grab it.
—Digital, just hold onto my hand so I don't slip.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: !? Th-That's way too dangerous, you can't! Why would you go that far...?!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Haha! Looks like our roles are totally reversed from when we saved that kitten, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
If I don't go down, you will.
...I know you. You're the kind of person who'd do anything for an umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —Well, guess what? I'll do anything for my *comrades* too.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ...So let me prove to you that I truly, seriously consider you my partner.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Who Stopped Crying
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you so, so much! If I leave right now, I can just barely make it...
Excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Well, case closed! ...Aren't you gonna be in trouble if you don't get going soon too?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ...Tap-san. ...Allow the unworthy Digi-tan to make a declaration right here and now.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: From this moment on... I shall perform my duties as Tap-san's "partner" with all my might!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —Heh. Finally... the key turned in the treasure chest.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph. So, you went and dismantled my logic, huh.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Well... to the very end, you're someone who gives me plenty of "special" data.
choice_data_list: You pushed your selfish wish all the way through, huh.
You pushed your selfish wish all the way through, huh.
Does that mean Shakur is a special comrade too...?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Well... to the very end, you're someone who gives me plenty of "special" data.
choice_data_list: You pushed your selfish wish all the way through, huh.
You pushed your selfish wish all the way through, huh.
Does that mean Shakur is a special comrade too...?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Now that things've turned out like this, we gotta come up with a special trio name! Right, Shakur?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Do whatever you want. Count me out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And yet. In the end, it seemed the name "Tracen Pirates" ended up sticking anyway.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Of course it did!
I will—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Claim any treasure there is! As long as there's romance in it!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Of course! Hey, Shakur! Say that word "special" again like you did earlier! C'mon, again!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Hey. Stop. You're annoyin'.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Even so, she didn't deny it. Perhaps that was her answer.
